ctx.x: Yeah, I caught some salmon when I went fishing.
Yeah. Now that 7 piece band was composed of Sam Taylor, Keg Ray Johnson and Jonah Jones. And you David and Francis on drums, and Dave Rivera on piano.
Yeah, and Milt Hinton on bass and Cab Calloway. Yeah.
